name: ai-studio
description: Google AI Studio integration for local nSelf instances: secure Cloudflare Tunnel bridge with schema-context injection and read-only enforcement.
author: nself

actions.bridge: Start a secure AI Studio bridge via Cloudflare Tunnel

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin managed by nself build/start: it has no port declared in the port registry, no database tables, and runs a self-managed local HTTP proxy plus a Cloudflare Tunnel subprocess only while `nself ai-studio bridge` is running in the foreground. Extracted from cli/cmd/aistudio/* under CLI-R11; the original package had zero internal/* imports (fully self-contained: Cloudflare Tunnel management, a read-only GraphQL proxy, and Postgres schema snapshotting all implemented locally), so this is a verbatim move — only the package name (aistudio -> main) and the root command's Use/Silence fields changed.
